name: Warmup
description: Starts your subscription agents' rolling usage windows on your own schedule: a one-word ping to each subscription agent, on its cheapest model, at the times of day you choose (05:00 / 10:00 / 15:00 / 20:00 by default) — so a window is already open when you sit down to work.
tagline: Open your usage windows before you sit down

permission_levels.label: Can view
permission_levels.description: See which subscription agents are warmed, on what schedule, and when each was last pinged.

permission_levels.label: Can ping now
permission_levels.description: Trigger a warmup ping immediately, which opens a usage window on that agent's subscription.

permission_levels.label: Can configure
permission_levels.description: Change which agents are warmed and at what times, which decides how much subscription quota is spent unattended.

chat_widget_templates.title: Warmup widget
chat_widget_templates.description: Warmup chat widget metadata is coming soon; no render tool is available yet.
